title: Report download slices analysis_id wrong: 'an-aoife' -> 'aoife', never matches the 'a-aoife' keys it looks up
evidence:
+  let application_id = string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)
+  let filename = case
+    list.find(demo_store.report_filenames(), fn(p) { p.0 == application_id })
... (doc comment) +/// `analysis_id` (e.g. "an-aoife")
+/// maps to the application id ("a-aoife") which keys the baked PDF.
... (demo_store.gleam) +    #("a-aoife", "RightTenantry-Report-Aoife-Ni-Riain.pdf"),
detail: drop_start("an-aoife", 3) yields "aoife", not "a-aoife". The find against report_filenames keys ("a-aoife" etc.) therefore always misses, the filename silently falls back, and the URL becomes /static/demo/report-aoife.pdf.
recommended_fix: Drop 2 characters ("an-") or prepend "a-": e.g. "a-" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3), so the id matches report_filenames keys.

title: substitute_reference discards the new referee details and the store wipes the contact to None instead of substituting
evidence:
+  let _ = name
+  let _ = email
+  let _ = phone
+  #(next, respond_result(result, on_response))
... +    "substitute" ->
+      ReferenceCallDetail(
+        ..call,
+        contact_name: None,
+        contact_email: None,
+        contact_phone: None,
+      )
detail: The API mirror takes name/email/phone for a substitute action, throws them away, and the store mutation clears the existing contact rather than recording the substitute referee. The demo shows a contact-less call after substitution.
recommended_fix: Thread name/email/phone through refcheck_action and set contact_name/email/phone to Some(new values) in the "substitute" branch.

title: UserConfirmedApproval refetches the leaderboard from the pre-mutation store
evidence:
+    UserConfirmedApproval(vid, aid) -> {
+      let #(updated, eff) = demo_status(model, vid, aid, "approved")
+      let store = store_of(model)
+      let leaderboard_eff =
+        demo_api.fetch_leaderboard(store, vid, ApiReturnedLeaderboard)
detail: demo_status returns `updated` carrying the mutated demo_store, but store_of(model) reads the old model, so the leaderboard refetch serves data without the approval the user just confirmed.
recommended_fix: Use store_of(updated) (or the `next` store returned inside demo_status) for the leaderboard refetch.

title: Approval refetches the leaderboard; rejection and backward transitions do not
evidence:
+    UserConfirmedRejection(vid, aid) -> {
+      let #(updated, eff) = demo_status(model, vid, aid, "rejected")
+      #(
+        Model(..updated, show_reject_confirm: False, pending_rejection: None),
+        eff,
+      )
+    }
+    UserConfirmedBackwardTransition(vid, aid, target) -> {
+      let #(updated, eff) = demo_status(model, vid, aid, target)
+      #(
+        Model(
+          ..updated,
+          show_backward_confirm: False,
+          pending_backward_transition: None,
+        ),
+        eff,
+      )
+    }
detail: Three sibling confirm arms mutate application status, but only approval batches a leaderboard refetch. Rejection/backward leave the leaderboard rows stale relative to the new status, an inconsistent treatment of identical mutations.
recommended_fix: Either refetch the leaderboard in all three arms (from the updated store) or none; make the status-confirm arms symmetric.

title: Module header claims everything is derived, yet vacancy_detail hardcodes remindable_count/followup_count for all vacancies
evidence:
+//// DERIVED, NOT SERIALIZED: the dashboard list, vacancy detail, leaderboard,
+//// application detail, comparison and archived views are all computed on
+//// demand from the single source of truth
... +    awaiting_count: awaiting_count_for(vac.id),
+    remindable_count: 2,
+    followup_count: 1,
detail: awaiting_count varies per vacancy via awaiting_count_for and the awaiting list only exists for v-maples, but remindable_count: 2 and followup_count: 1 are constants for every vacancy — including v-harbour whose awaiting list is empty.
recommended_fix: Derive remindable/followup counts from the awaiting fixture list (reminded/followup_due flags) instead of hardcoding.

title: create_vacancy sets closes_at equal to created_at, ignoring validity_days
evidence:
+      validity_days: payload.validity_days,
+      max_applications: 20,
+      created_at: now,
+      closes_at: now,
detail: A vacancy the demo user just created is born with closes_at == created_at, and demo_days_remaining returns 0 for any v-demo-* id — the newly created vacancy immediately presents as closing today/zero days remaining.
recommended_fix: Compute closes_at as the demo clock plus payload.validity_days, and give v-demo-* ids a sensible days_remaining derivation.

title: mark_opened logs event_type 'status_auto_changed' but its details payload says trigger 'manual'
evidence:
+pub fn mark_opened(
... +    "under_review",
+    "status_auto_changed",
+  )
... +                    audit_trail: list.append(app.audit_trail, [
+                      AuditEntry(
+                        event_type:,
+                        details: Some(
+                          "{\"to\":\"" <> slug <> "\",\"trigger\":\"manual\"}",
+                        ),
detail: change_status hardcodes details trigger "manual" for every caller, so the auto-transition emitted by mark_opened carries an audit details payload that contradicts its own event_type.
recommended_fix: Pass the trigger label through change_status ("auto" for mark_opened, "manual" for set_status) and interpolate it into details.

title: Demo logout fires the demo_reset analytics event, conflating exit with reset
detail: Signing out of the demo is tracked as demo_reset, the same event fired by an actual in-demo reset. Two distinct user actions collapse into one metric; the constants list defines no exit event.
recommended_fix: Add a demo_exit event constant and fire it on logout, reserving demo_reset for UserClickedResetDemo.

title: bulk_reject return count is computed from the pre-mutation store and counts already-rejected rows
detail: The count filters `store` (before the update) and counts every id match regardless of prior status, so re-rejecting already-rejected applications is reported as freshly rejected.
recommended_fix: Count only applications whose status actually transitioned to Rejected (e.g. filter out a.application.status == Rejected before counting).

title: Six demo_api refcheck wrappers and most analytics event constants have no call site anywhere in this diff
evidence:
+pub fn start_check(
... +pub fn skip_reference(
... +pub fn re_enable_reference(
... +pub fn take_over_reference(
... +pub fn correct_reference(
... +pub const demo_entry = "demo_entry"
+pub const demo_vacancy_open = "demo_vacancy_open"
+pub const demo_application_open = "demo_application_open"
+pub const demo_comparison_open = "demo_comparison_open"
+pub const demo_archived_open = "demo_archived_open"
+pub const demo_report_download = "demo_report_download"
+pub const demo_create_vacancy_open = "demo_create_vacancy_open"
detail: demo_update dispatches every reference-check action through demo_api.refcheck_action directly; start_check/skip_reference/re_enable_reference/take_over_reference/correct_reference/substitute_reference and seven of the nine event constants are never referenced in the chunk.
recommended_fix: Delete the uncalled wrappers and unused constants, or wire the dispatcher through the typed wrappers and fire the surface events at the corresponding views.
